communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: FCC & White House Communications
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Communications between the White House and the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) from January 20, 2025, through the date this request is processed.

Specifically, I seek the following records:

1. Emails, text messages, memoranda, letters, meeting notes, and call logs between White House officials and FCC commissioners, employees, or other representatives of the Commission.
2. Communications concerning FCC regulatory actions, investigations, enforcement decisions, or policy changes.
3. Communications concerning the regulation of broadcast television, radio, telecommunications, internet services, or media organizations.
4. Records of meetings, telephone calls, or other substantive interactions between White House officials and FCC leadership.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Evan Bruner

communications.subject: Illinois Freedom of Information Act. Request: Red Line Accident Report
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I hereby request the following records:

1.	Records documenting the number of reported accidents, collisions, derailments, and other reportable safety incidents involving CTA Red Line trains from January 1, 2022, to the date this request is processed.
	2.	Records documenting the number of passengers injured or killed in incidents involving Red Line trains, including incident dates and injury classifications from January 1, 2022, to the date this request is processed.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Evan Bruner

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: White House & FCC Communications
communications.communication:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Records of communications between the White House and the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) from January 20, 2025, through the date this request is processed.

1. Emails, text messages, memoranda, letters, meeting notes, call logs, and other written or electronically stored communications between White House officials and FCC commissioners, employees, or other representatives of the Commission.
2. Communications concerning FCC regulatory actions, investigations, enforcement decisions, proposed rules, or policy changes.
3. Communications concerning the regulation of broadcast television, radio, telecommunications, internet services, or media organizations.
4. Records of meetings, telephone calls, or other substantive interactions between White House officials and FCC leadership, including calendars, agendas, briefing materials, and follow-up correspondence.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Evan Bruner

title: Incident Reports at 2111 Television Pl, Kansas City, MO 64126

communications.subject: The Missouri Sunshine Law Request: Incident Reports at 2111 Television Pl, Kansas City, MO 64126
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the The Missouri Sunshine Law, I hereby request the following records:

All reports generated by the Jackson County Sheriff's Office concerning conduct or incidents on the premises of the establishment located at 2111 Television Pl, Kansas City, MO, 64126, from the year 2000 until the present. 

The Jackson County Sheriff's Office was called to the premises of 2111 Television Pl 100 times between 2016 and 2022 for events including, but not limited to, noise complaints, shootings, health code violations, theft and rape.

I understand that many of the responsive records may contain sensitive, confidential information. I request that any personal information be redacted from records which contain personal or otherwise un-releasable information. Alleged conduct at this address, and the response from the Jackson County Sheriff's Office and other law enforcement agencies, have both been the subject of extensive public reporting and inquiry. A Kansas City Star article from March 27, 2023 has been added for context.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

A. Gray
